name: mathjax
description: Beautiful and accessible math in all browsers. MathJax is an open-source JavaScript display engine for LaTeX, MathML, and AsciiMath notation that works in all browsers. This package includes the packaged components (install mathjax-full to get the source code).

scripts.clean: pnpm run --silent clean:es5 && pnpm run --silent clean:node
scripts.title: pnpm run --silent line && pnpm run --silent message --mathjax:message="${npm_package_config_title}"
scripts.install:all: pnpm run --silent install:mj3 && pnpm run --silent install:mj3-deps
scripts.make-es5: pnpm run --silent install:all && pnpm run --silent compile && pnpm run --silent components && pnpm run --silent move
scripts.postmake-es5: pnpm run --silent title --mathjax:title='Cleaning Up...' && pnpm run --silent clean:node
scripts.get-es5: pnpm run --silent install:mj3 && pnpm run --silent move
scripts.postget-es5: pnpm run --silent title --mathjax:title='Cleaning Up...' && pnpm run --silent clean:node
